newsitem.title: UK: Safeway jumps on talk of upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Safeway jumps on talk of upgrades.

text.p: Shares in British supermarket group Safeway Plc jumped by more than two percent on Thursday after Merrill Lynch recommended buying the stock, dealers said.
Analysts at Merrill Lynch were not immediately available to comment, but dealers said the brokerage also told its clients to buy shares in Tesco Plc and ASDA Group Plc as part of a sector review.
Safeway shares were up 8p at 357-1/2p by 1210 GMT. Shares in Tesco added 1-1/2p to 346-1/2p, while shares in ASDA climbed 1-1/4p to 112-3/4p.
Dealers also noted talk that brokerage Morgan Stanley was positive on the stock.
Morgan Stanley supermarket analyst Peter Brockwell declined comment.
"I think another couple (of brokerages) may be looking at doing that sort of thing," a market maker said.
